title: Volumetric Flasks

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Flasks calibrated to hold a precise volume at a single fill line, used for accurately preparing solutions of a known concentration.
safety: Fill to the calibration line with the meniscus bottom aligned to the mark, viewed at eye level.
Not intended for mixing or heating — mix the solution in a separate container before final transfer, or invert gently to mix after filling to the line.
